verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) indexing 529 doc pages via a dedicated _llms/docs.txt. The docs also publish agent-oriented markdown bundles (_llms/api-reference.md, _llms/sdks.md) and skill files written for agents (cdp-cli/skill.md, agentic-wallet skills with 'Use when you or the user want to…' triggers). missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs in practice.
